implementedContract: Tab and browser modifier shortcuts release held commands and are not prevented.
Canvas and mission HUD focus changes release commands. HUD buttons keep native focus and Enter/Space activation.
Leaving mission surfaces while playing, window blur, hidden documents, hasFocus fallback and pagehide suspend the mission.
Focus return does not resume the mission. Resume while the page is hidden or unfocused is rejected.
Mission keyboard actions are accepted from the canvas. A canvas pointer press restores its focus.
A repeated keydown cannot rearm an input cleared by focus loss or pause; a new press can.
Remapped pause is edge-triggered per key press.
Lost pointer capture clears primary and secondary fire, without cancelling an unrelated keyboard hold.
Standard gamepad neutral-release handling remains in place.

modeledLimits: The harness executes the actual offline script with real handlers and simulation.
Element.focus models synchronous blur/focus with relatedTarget. It is not native browser focus behavior.
defaultPrevented checks establish that Enter and Space are not intercepted. Resulting button clicks are dispatched separately because the harness does not synthesize browser activation.
No browser, CSS, native dialog, hardware keyboard/gamepad/touch, real download or audio verification is claimed.
The worn-radiator fixture is deliberate test input, not evidence of a played damage route.
nativeProtocol: In-page navigation: from a quiet mission start, hold D then Tab to Pause and Repair. Movement must settle, native focus must remain visible, and Enter/Space must activate each button. Refocus canvas: the old held repeat stays inert until a fresh key press.
External tab: repeat the original held-D click on another browser tab, then return. Record paused dialog, unchanged elapsed time and no automatic resume.
Address bar: separately repeat the original held-D click on the address bar. A Ctrl+L check is useful but cannot replace this original click case.
Explicit resume: use Reprendre; old movement and fire must remain released. A new press must operate normally.
Pointer capture: fire, leave/release the pointer, return and confirm that no unattended firing remains.
Record native outcomes independently of this modeled report. Keep QA19 open if native behavior remains contradictory.
